tim_output.campaign_summary: Rhysida ransomware, active since May 2023 and attributed to Vice Society (DEV-0832) threat actors, has targeted education, healthcare, manufacturing, IT, and government sectors. The group employs living-off-the-land techniques leveraging legitimate tools (PsExec, PowerShell, RDP) for initial access via compromised VPN credentials and lateral movement, followed by data encryption using 4096-bit RSA with ChaCha20 algorithms, and double extortion demanding Bitcoin ransom. Updated indicators as of April 2025 include new IOCs associated with Gootloader malware, AZCopy, and cloud storage exploitation tools used for lateral movement and data exfiltration.
